description: Production-oriented hybrid multimodal relevance evaluation system for freelance deliverables
author: ProofFlow AI Research & MLOps Team

architecture.component_a: Requirement and Constraint Understanding (Structured Criteria Parser)
architecture.component_b: Text Relevance and Semantic Matching (Ridge Regression on TF-IDF + Length Ratios)
architecture.component_c: Functional & Technical Evaluator (Objective Test Verification + AST Code Syntax Analyzer)
architecture.component_d: Visual and Multimodal Evaluator (Modular VLM Adapter for Image/UI deliverables)
architecture.component_e: Evidence-Aware Dynamic Score Aggregator (Renormalized Category Rubrics)

training_provenance.group_split_strategy: GroupKFold on data_split_group (225 unique document/prompt groups)
